items.name: Reloved Metropolitan Carryall Bag
items.notes:
Pre-owned and now (re)loved, this Metropolitan Carryall Bag is a very special Coach custom design inspired by our commitment to rethinking and reducing our impact on the planet. Saved from the landfill, this gently-worn bag was lovingly repaired and transformed by our in-house craftspeople who added clever details to give it a second life. It’s completely one-of-a-kind, and comes with its own unique set of charms. Wear it, love it, pass it on.

Reimagined by Savannah Sutton with dark whipstitching for rich dimension and a distinctive touch, this generously proportioned style has been expertly cleaned, conditioned and restored. Our talented craftspeople Alfred Deaza and Yngrid Pichard Baez hand-decorated the front overlays with chunky whipstitch details, replaced the long strap with a blue one, polished the bottom feet and added a playful repurposed charm. The Metropolitan is a no-fuss design made for the modern man. Crafted of our buttery soft glovetanned leather, this streamlined Carryall has an outside pocket for easy access to essentials and a roomy interior with multifunction organizational pockets and an interior sleeve to hold a 16" laptop. Finished with a lock for the dual zippers, a key hood and hangtag for a luxe Coach touch, hold the tote by the top handles or attach the lightweight webbing strap for hands-free wear.

items.name: Herbag Zip Retourne Cabine – Toile Criss Viking / Vache Hunter, Ecru-Noir & Noir (H077785CK AD)
items.notes:
The Herbag Zip Retourne Cabine in Toile Criss Viking is the more graphic iteration of the travel Herbag — the small-scale black and white check canvas is a house signature that reads as quietly distinctive rather than logo-forward, and pairs cleanly with the Noir Vache Hunter leather trim.

At the Cabine scale, this is a serious travel piece: large enough to function as a carry-on, structured enough to hold its shape, and light enough in construction that it doesn't add meaningful weight to your load.

This example was purchased at the Hermès boutique at 42 Avenue George V, Paris on June 11, 2022. Light travel use only, stored in its dustbag, with no visible wear to the Vache Hunter leather trim.

items.name: Hac à Dos GM – Veau Barenia Faubourg, Fauve (H083848CK34)
items.notes:
The Hac à Dos is among the most considered pieces in the modern Hermès lineup — rooted in the DNA of the legendary Haut à Courroies, reimagined as a backpack for daily life. This GM (Grand Modèle) example is crafted in Barenia Faubourg, the most prestigious leather in the Hac à Dos range and among the most coveted in the entire Hermès universe.

Barenia Faubourg is exclusive to Hermès, associated with the storied Maison at 24 Faubourg Saint-Honoré. Smooth and waxy to the touch, it develops a rich, individual patina over time — a quality that separates it from every other leather in the house.

The colorway is Fauve (CK34) — a warm, luminous honey-tan that works across every season and context. Palladium hardware provides a clean, lasting finish.

This piece was purchased directly from the Hermès boutique at 17 Rue de Sèvres, Paris in May 2023 at the then-boutique price of €8,450 EUR. It has been barely used and was recently professionally conditioned at an official Hermès boutique spa — the leather is in exceptional health and perfectly prepared for its next chapter of wear and patina development. Current retail for this configuration now stands at approximately $13,600 USD, reflecting significant price appreciation since purchase.

items.name: Pocket Organiser – American Alligator, Navy Blue (N91553)
items.notes:
Crafted from genuine American Alligator (Alligator mississippiensis), this Louis Vuitton Pocket Organiser represents the pinnacle of exotic leather goods. The American alligator — prized for its larger, more uniform scale pattern and exceptional skin quality — is the material of choice for the world's finest luxury houses. Each piece is unique by nature.

Despite its slim profile, it is remarkably functional: five interior pockets, one exterior pocket, and three dedicated credit card slots. It slips effortlessly into a jacket pocket or bag without bulk — an everyday carry that happens to be an heirloom.

The Navy Blue colorway is rich and versatile, working equally well with tailored suiting or casual dress.

This piece is accompanied by its original CITES export documentation issued in France, confirming the species as Alligator mississippiensis and certifying its legal origin. For serious collectors and international buyers, this documentation is essential and increasingly rare with pre-owned exotic goods.
